simple.summary: שַׁחֲצוֹם (Shachătsôwm) means Shachatsom , a place in Palestine First listed occurrence: Josh 19 22.

definitions.full: H7831. Shachatsom שׁחצומה Kt, שַׁחֲצִ֫ימָה Qr (i.e. [ שַׁחֲצִים ] + הָ֯ ) proper name, of a location in Issachar Josh 19:22 ; ἐπὶ Σαλειμ κατἀ θάλασσαν , A ᵐ5 L Σασειμα ( θ ).
